performance.verdict: Budget cut explains volume drop; CPL efficiency gain is real but fragile.

findings.text: Spend fell to $27.69/day (7d avg) from ~$64/day prior 7d — CPL improved to ~$9 from ~$12, but lead volume dropped 37% as a direct result of budget withdrawal, not ad failure.
Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) remains open — 64 GBP calls in 28d cannot be tied to paid campaigns, understating true CPL and scoreboard lead count.
Sync items + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) still overdue — GHL shows 84 opps created but 0 won and 0 appointments, meaning intake conversion is invisible and the August scoreboard is unscoreable.

3-day signal (Aug 18–20): leads 5, 4, 0 vs prior 3 days (Aug 15–17): 2, 8, 5 — last day at 0 leads with $21.99 spend; IG reach collapsed to 89 on Aug 20, lowest in 45 days, signalling fatigue or budget floor hit.

GA4 sessions rose 79.66% week-over-week (22–19–11 last 3 days) while paid spend shrank — organic or direct traffic driving site visits with 0 GA4 conversions tracked, suggesting broken conversion event.

suggestions.text: Fix phone-match attribution gap immediately — 64 unattributed GBP calls in 28d are hiding true lead count from the August scoreboard.
